title: Reproducibility software and data for: When predictive fit and screening utility diverge: choosing frequency or particle size in roadside-soil magnetometry
description:
Reproducibility software and research data accompanying the manuscript 'When predictive fit and screening utility diverge: choosing frequency or particle size in roadside-soil magnetometry'. The study is a secondary analysis of an archived 44-sample roadside-soil campaign along the Amman-Airport Highway, Jordan, including 43 complete fine/coarse magnetic pairs and nine measured metal concentrations. The materials support examination of prediction error, held-out screening recovery, nested measurement selection, frequency-representation sensitivity, block-deletion sensitivity and conditional resource accounting. Included source data and executable workflows are intended for reproducing and checking the reported analyses. The execution report supplied with the release records the checks actually completed and their scope. The archive does not establish independent geographic validation. Original software is licensed under MIT; author-owned data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0, as specified in LICENSING.md. Third-party materials retain their original terms.

The original campaign measured chemistry on one analytical portion per sample; the magnetic measurements cover fine and coarse fractions at two frequencies. The original workbook is provided unchanged as 04_M-Ghraam2026_ORIGINAL_UNCHANGED.xlsx (SHA-256: 4ff48393b15d83306e9099efa30e12ee2d797cd57a0b75c44b8f99726380becb). The supplied analysis table, source-cell verification and executable extension workflows accompany the workbook. The historical source-table generator is not claimed to have been recovered.

Campaign sources: Al-Momani, I. F., Lataifeh, M. S., and Al-Gharram, M. S. (2026), Measurement of Magnetic Susceptibility and Heavy Metals Concentration in Roadside Topsoil along Amman-Airport Highway, Jordan, Jordan Journal of Physics, 19(2), 213-222. Publisher record. Al-Gharram, M. S. S. (2022), Measurement of Magnetic Susceptibility and Heavy Metals Concentration in Roadside Topsoil along Amman-Airport Highway, Jordan, Master's thesis, Yarmouk University.
